summary: Split the single reservation.ts module into an inventory module (stock ownership) and a reservation module (hold lifecycle), so future stock-related work (e.g. multi-warehouse) doesn't need to touch hold/TTL/authZ logic. Design-only: this repository's implementation intentionally stays a single file for now (see README "Out of scope").

modules.responsibility: Own available stock per SKU; expose stock read/adjust operations.
Own hold lifecycle (reserve/release/expire/lookup) and TTL/authZ enforcement.

dependencies.reason: Reserving and releasing a hold must read and adjust available stock.

constraints.reason: Stock ownership must stay independent of hold/TTL/authZ concerns so inventory can be reused (e.g. multi-warehouse) without carrying reservation logic.
